title: English
blurb: Gramática e vocabulário em inglês, explicados em português.

lessons.title: Tempos verbais sem confusão
lessons.summary: Os quatro pares de tempos que mais baralham quem fala português.

cards.title: Present simple ou present continuous?
cards.text:
Usa o *present simple* para hábitos, rotinas e verdades gerais: *I work in Porto.* (Trabalho no Porto.)

Usa o *present continuous* (am/is/are + -ing) para o que está a acontecer agora ou é temporário: *I'm working from home this week.* (Esta semana estou a trabalhar em casa.)

Truque: se em português dirias "estou a…", em inglês é quase sempre o continuous.
cards.say: I work in Porto. I'm working from home this week.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><circle class="fpen" cx="34" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="60" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="86" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="112" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="138" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="164" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="190" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="216" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="242" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="268" cy="66" r="4.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="294" cy="66" r="4.5"/><path class="a" d="M20 110L304 110"/><path class="a" d="M296.8 113.5L304 110L296.8 106.5"/><rect class="y" x="166" y="98" width="76" height="24" rx="4" transform="rotate(-1.2 166 98)"/><path class="r" d="M204 96L204 124"/></g><text class="a" x="20" y="40" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">hábito: I work in Porto.</text><text class="r" x="204" y="144" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">agora</text><text class="r" x="160" y="172" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">temporário: I'm working from home.</text></svg>

cards.title: Past simple ou present perfect?
cards.text:
O *past simple* fala de um momento terminado e definido: *I visited London in 2019.*

O *present perfect* (have/has + particípio) liga o passado ao presente, sem dizer quando: *I have visited London twice.* (Já visitei Londres duas vezes.)

Erro típico: *I have seen him yesterday* ✗. Com yesterday, last week, in 2019 ou ago, usa sempre o past simple: *I saw him yesterday* ✓.
cards.say: I visited London in 2019. I have visited London twice. I saw him yesterday.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="a" d="M20 62L304 62"/><path class="a" d="M296.8 65.5L304 62L296.8 58.5"/><circle class="fred" cx="96" cy="62" r="6"/><path class="r" d="M96 50L96 74"/><path class="a" d="M20 140L304 140"/><path class="a" d="M296.8 143.5L304 140L296.8 136.5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="70" cy="140" r="5"/><circle class="fpen" cx="140" cy="140" r="5"/><path class="r" d="M276 128L276 152"/><path class="a" d="M140 136 Q208 92 272 132"/><path class="a" d="M258 120L272 132"/><path class="a" d="M265.2 130.2L272 132L269.2 125.6"/></g><text class="r" x="20" y="30" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:16px">past simple: in 2019 (terminado)</text><text class="r" x="96" y="92" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">2019</text><text class="a" x="20" y="112" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:16px">present perfect: até agora</text><text class="r" x="276" y="170" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:15px">agora</text><text class="" x="105" y="166" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:14px">quando? não importa</text></svg>

cards.title: For ou since?
cards.text: Os dois traduzem o nosso "há" ou "desde" quando falamos de algo que ainda continua. Usa *for* com quanto tempo dura; usa *since* com o momento em que começou. Ambos pedem o present perfect.
example: I have lived here for 10 years.
cards.say: I have lived here for ten years. I have lived here since 2016.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="a" d="M20 96L304 96"/><path class="a" d="M296.8 99.5L304 96L296.8 92.5"/><path class="r" d="M72 82L72 110"/><path class="s" d="M276 82L276 110"/><path class="a" d="M72 128L276 128"/><path class="a" d="M72 120L72 136"/><path class="a" d="M276 120L276 136"/></g><text class="" x="160" y="30" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:19px">I have lived here…</text><text class="r" x="72" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">since 2016</text><text class="" x="276" y="72" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">agora</text><text class="a" x="174" y="156" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:18px">for 10 years</text></svg>

cards.title: Will ou going to?
cards.text:
*Going to* é para planos já decididos ou quando há um sinal à vista: *I'm going to fly to London on Friday.* *Look at those clouds, it's going to rain.*

*Will* é para decisões tomadas no momento, promessas e previsões gerais: *The phone's ringing. I'll get it!* *I'll call you later.*
cards.say: I'm going to fly to London on Friday. The phone's ringing. I'll get it!
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><rect class="s bgf" x="36" y="46" width="96" height="82" rx="6"/><rect class="w" x="36" y="46" width="96" height="20" rx="0"/><path class="s" d="M58 38L58 54"/><path class="s" d="M110 38L110 54"/><path class="a" d="M62 98 L78 112 L108 80"/><circle class="s bgf" cx="236" cy="80" r="28"/><rect class="s bgf" x="224" y="108" width="24" height="16" rx="3"/><path class="r" d="M226 92 L231 78 L236 92 L241 78 L246 92"/><path class="r" d="M236 36L236 44"/><path class="r" d="M270 56L278 50"/><path class="r" d="M202 56L194 50"/></g><text class="a" x="84" y="150" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:18px">plano: going to</text><text class="r" x="236" y="150" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:18px">agora mesmo: will</text></svg>

quiz.explain: Com yesterday (momento terminado e definido) usa-se o past simple: I saw him yesterday.
2020 é o ponto de partida, por isso since. Com uma duração seria for (for six years).

quiz.q: Look at the sky! It ___ rain.
quiz.explain: Há um sinal visível agora (as nuvens), por isso going to.
Está a acontecer neste momento: present continuous (am writing).

lessons.title: Falsos amigos
lessons.summary: Palavras que parecem portuguesas mas querem dizer outra coisa.

cards.title: Parece, mas não é
cards.text:
Os falsos amigos são palavras inglesas parecidas com palavras portuguesas, mas com outro significado. São a fonte de muitos erros de quem fala bem inglês.

*Actually* não é "atualmente" (isso é *currently*). *Pretend* não é "pretender" (isso é *intend*). E numa porta, *push* quer dizer empurrar, não puxar.
cards.say: Actually, I currently live in Portugal. Push the door.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="dash" d="M16 34L304 34"/><path class="r" d="M116 54.6L191.4 54.6"/><path class="r" d="M116 86.6L184.3 86.6"/><path class="r" d="M116 118.6L155.7 118.6"/><path class="r" d="M116 150.6L177.1 150.6"/></g><text class="a" x="16" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">English</text><text class="r" x="118" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">parece…</text><text class="" x="222" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">significa</text><text class="a" x="16" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">actually</text><text class="" x="118" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">atualmente</text><text class="" x="222" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">na verdade</text><text class="a" x="16" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">pretend</text><text class="" x="118" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">pretender</text><text class="" x="222" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">fingir</text><text class="a" x="16" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">push</text><text class="" x="118" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">puxar</text><text class="" x="222" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">empurrar</text><text class="a" x="16" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">library</text><text class="" x="118" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">livraria</text><text class="" x="222" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">biblioteca</text></svg>

cards.title: Mais quatro armadilhas
cards.text:
• *exquisite* = requintado (esquisito é *weird* ou *picky*)
• *assist* = ajudar (assistir a uma reunião é *attend*; ver um jogo é *watch*)
• *eventually* = por fim, finalmente (eventualmente é *possibly*)
• *parents* = pai e mãe (os parentes são *relatives*)

Exemplo: *I'll attend the meeting* = vou assistir à reunião.
cards.say: I'll attend the meeting. The flight eventually took off.

cards.title: Treina: 12 falsos amigos
cards.text: Lê a palavra em inglês, tenta lembrar-te do significado e toca no cartão para confirmar. Usa Ouvir para treinar a pronúncia.
items: Actually, I've never been to Paris.
Push the door to open it.
I borrowed this book from the library.
Can I assist you with your bags?
The flight eventually took off at ten.
I didn't realize it was so late.
I can't come, I have a cold.
She was very sympathetic when I was ill.
This fabric is made of cotton.

cards.title: Sensible, sensitive, sympathetic
cards.text:
Três palavras que enganam quase toda a gente:
• *sensible* = sensato, com bom senso: *a sensible decision*
• *sensitive* = sensível: *sensitive skin*, *a sensitive topic*
• *sympathetic* = compreensivo, solidário. Para "simpático" diz *nice* ou *friendly*.
cards.say: That's a sensible decision. I have sensitive skin. Our neighbours are very friendly.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="dash" d="M16 34L304 34"/><path class="r" d="M116 54.6L177.1 54.6"/><path class="r" d="M116 118.6L184.3 118.6"/></g><text class="a" x="16" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">English</text><text class="r" x="118" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">parece…</text><text class="" x="222" y="26" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:15px">significa</text><text class="a" x="16" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">sensible</text><text class="" x="118" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">sensível</text><text class="" x="222" y="60" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">sensato</text><text class="a" x="16" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">sensitive</text><text class="" x="118" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">—</text><text class="" x="222" y="92" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">sensível</text><text class="a" x="16" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">sympathetic</text><text class="" x="118" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">simpático</text><text class="" x="222" y="124" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">compreensivo</text><text class="a" x="16" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">nice, friendly</text><text class="" x="118" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:17px">—</text><text class="" x="222" y="156" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">simpático</text></svg>

quiz.explain: Eventually = por fim. Para "eventualmente" diz possibly ou perhaps.

quiz.q: "My manager is very sympathetic" quer dizer que é…
quiz.explain: Sympathetic = compreensivo. Simpático diz-se nice ou friendly.

lessons.title: Preposições e verbos do dia a dia
lessons.summary: in, on, at; make ou do; phrasal verbs e os erros mais comuns.

cards.title: In, on, at no tempo
cards.text:
Pensa num funil, do mais largo para o mais preciso:
• *in* para períodos longos: meses, anos, estações e partes do dia (*in May*, *in 2026*, *in the morning*)
• *on* para dias e datas: *on Monday*, *on 25 April*
• *at* para horas e momentos exatos: *at 9:00*, *at night*, *at the weekend* (inglês britânico)
cards.say: In May. On Monday. At nine o'clock.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><rect class="s bgf" x="20" y="22" width="280" height="42" rx="6"/><rect class="s bgf" x="60" y="72" width="200" height="42" rx="6"/><rect class="s bgf" x="100" y="122" width="120" height="42" rx="6"/></g><text class="r" x="36" y="50" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:24px">in</text><text class="" x="176" y="49" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">May · 2026 · the morning</text><text class="r" x="74" y="100" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:24px">on</text><text class="" x="176" y="99" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">Monday · 25 April</text><text class="r" x="110" y="150" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:24px">at</text><text class="" x="172" y="149" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:16px">9:00 · night</text></svg>

cards.title: In, on, at no espaço
cards.text:
• *in* = dentro de um espaço fechado ou de uma área: *in the box*, *in the car*, *in Lisbon*
• *on* = em cima de uma superfície: *on the table*, *on the wall*, *on the second floor*
• *at* = num ponto ou local concreto: *at the door*, *at the airport*, *at work*
cards.say: The keys are in the box. The cup is on the table. I'm at the airport.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="s" d="M28 62 V132 H102 V62"/><circle class="fpen" cx="65" cy="114" r="14"/><path class="s" d="M124 112L196 112"/><path class="s" d="M134 112L134 140"/><path class="s" d="M186 112L186 140"/><circle class="fpen" cx="160" cy="97" r="14"/><rect class="s bgf" x="252" y="54" width="42" height="86" rx="2"/><circle class="fi" cx="284" cy="100" r="3"/><circle class="fpen" cx="232" cy="126" r="13"/><path class="s" d="M214 140L304 140"/></g><text class="r" x="65" y="40" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:26px">in</text><text class="r" x="160" y="40" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:26px">on</text><text class="r" x="262" y="40" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:26px">at</text><text class="" x="65" y="166" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:15px">in the box</text><text class="" x="160" y="166" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:15px">on the table</text><text class="" x="262" y="166" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:15px">at the door</text></svg>

cards.title: Make ou do?
cards.text:
Os dois traduzem "fazer".
• *make* = criar ou produzir alguma coisa: *make a decision*, *make a mistake*, *make money*, *make a cake*
• *do* = tarefas, atividades e trabalho: *do homework*, *do the dishes*, *do business*, *do your best*

Não há uma regra perfeita: o melhor é aprender as combinações.
cards.say: Make a decision. Make a mistake. Do your homework. Do your best.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="dash" d="M160 24L160 172"/></g><text class="r" x="80" y="40" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:26px">MAKE</text><text class="" x="80" y="60" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:14px">criar · produzir</text><text class="" x="80" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">a decision</text><text class="" x="80" y="110" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">a mistake</text><text class="" x="80" y="132" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">money</text><text class="" x="80" y="154" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">a cake</text><text class="a" x="240" y="40" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:26px">DO</text><text class="" x="240" y="60" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:14px">tarefas · atividades</text><text class="" x="240" y="88" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">homework</text><text class="" x="240" y="110" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">the dishes</text><text class="" x="240" y="132" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">business</text><text class="" x="240" y="154" text-anchor="middle" style="font-size:17px">your best</text></svg>

cards.title: Treina: 10 phrasal verbs
cards.text: Phrasal verbs são verbos com uma partícula (up, out, after…) que muda o significado. São muito usados no dia a dia e nas reuniões. Toca no cartão para ver a tradução.
items: Can you look after the kids tonight?
I'm looking forward to seeing you.
I can't figure out this app.
Let me find out when the train leaves.
She turned down the job offer.
I set up a new server at home.

cards.title: Cinco erros típicos de portugueses
cards.text:
Traduzir à letra do português leva a estes erros:
• idade usa o verbo *be*: *I'm 40* (ou *I'm 40 years old*)
• *people* é plural: *people are*
• *explain* pede *to*: *explain to me*
• *agree* é um verbo, sem *am*: *I agree*
• *depend* usa *on*: *it depends on the weather*
cards.say: I'm forty. People are friendly here. Can you explain it to me? I agree. It depends on the weather.
cards.sketch: <svg viewBox="0 0 320 180" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"><g class="d"><path class="r" d="M16 24.2L133.4 24.2"/><path class="s" d="M158 24L184 24"/><path class="s" d="M178.6 26.6L184 24L178.6 21.4"/><path class="r" d="M16 56.2L88 56.2"/><path class="s" d="M158 56L184 56"/><path class="s" d="M178.6 58.6L184 56L178.6 53.4"/><path class="r" d="M16 88.2L95.6 88.2"/><path class="s" d="M158 88L184 88"/><path class="s" d="M178.6 90.6L184 88L178.6 85.4"/><path class="r" d="M16 120.2L88 120.2"/><path class="s" d="M158 120L184 120"/><path class="s" d="M178.6 122.6L184 120L178.6 117.4"/><path class="r" d="M16 152.2L95.6 152.2"/><path class="s" d="M158 152L184 152"/><path class="s" d="M178.6 154.6L184 152L178.6 149.4"/></g><text class="" x="18" y="30" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:18px">I have 40 years</text><text class="a" x="192" y="30" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">I'm 40</text><text class="" x="18" y="62" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:18px">people is</text><text class="a" x="192" y="62" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">people are</text><text class="" x="18" y="94" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:18px">explain me</text><text class="a" x="192" y="94" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">explain to me</text><text class="" x="18" y="126" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:18px">I'm agree</text><text class="a" x="192" y="126" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">I agree</text><text class="" x="18" y="158" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:18px">depends of</text><text class="a" x="192" y="158" text-anchor="start" style="font-size:19px">depends on</text></svg>

quiz.explain: Dias levam on; horas levam at: on Monday at 10:00.

quiz.q: We need to ___ a decision today.
quiz.explain: Decisões "fazem-se" com make: make a decision.
Em inglês a idade usa o verbo be: I'm 40 ou I'm 40 years old.
